knowledge_gaps: The proposed bias mapping is consistent with PyTorch's update-gate convention, but input and recurrent contributions mean it does not establish actual retention horizons. The report needs to distinguish nominal initialization from measured gate behavior.

Baseline versus diverse-timescale initialization cannot separate the effect of increasing average retention from the effect of distributing retention across coordinates. A prespecified constant-bias control would clarify this without combining independently trained predictors.

Execution failures remain unexplained. Any necessary padding or readout correction must apply identically to both comparison arms; otherwise the initialization-only comparison is confounded. Difficulty 2 describes the bias edit, but understates the unresolved integration work.

The report lacks a concrete checkpoint-selection rule, remaining compute allocation, and handling of validation ties. Repeated checkpoint and configuration selection can overfit the fixed 200 validation users per category.
